Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 09-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Delhi Project Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the Project Associate position at IIT Delhi is September 9, 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Computer Science or an equivalent qualification. Additional experience in specific areas is also desirable.

faq.question: Q3. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to prepare your application with all necessary documents and send it to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 54,600 per month for the Project Associate role.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Project Associate role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Associate position will primarily involve an Online Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Project Associate position at IIT Delhi is a contractual job. This means the employment is for a fixed tenure as per the project requirements.

faq.question: Q8. Where is IIT Delhi located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Delhi is located in New Delhi, Delhi, with the pincode 110016.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this Project Associate recruitment at IIT Delhi is IITD/IRD/229/2026.

faq.question: Q10. Does IIT Delhi offer age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The official notification does not explicitly detail age relaxation for reserved categories. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for precise information regarding age limits and relaxations.
